verdicts.reason: A has a clear left-to-right flow: logo and product on the left, then headline, CTA and legal on the right. Its flaws: the headline almost touches the right edge, there is a dead gap between the can and the text column, and the legal line is microscopic. B blows the headline up so large that 'fizz' wraps onto its own line as an orphan and overpowers the product. It also squeezes the legal text into a tiny two-line block jammed beside the CTA, right against the corner circle, and crowds the can toward the bottom-left edge.
